summary:
This repository is a React + Vite account-signup demo (`src/pages/Signup.jsx`, `Login.jsx`, `Welcome.jsx`, shared CSS in `src/style.css`). There is no Angular, no `AppModule`/NgModule, no Bootstrap 4, no navbar, no tutorials entity and no `src/index.html` or `src/styles.css` — so items 1–3 describe an application that does not exist here and I did not invent one. I took the smaller reading: apply item 4's visual polish to the app this repo actually has.

Changed:
- `index.html` (repo root — this project's entry HTML): linked the Inter Google font with preconnects.
- `src/style.css` (the shared stylesheet this project already uses): light grey page background and Inter as the base font; one consistent indigo→purple colour scheme (gradient accent bar on the card, gradient primary button); rounded inputs with a clear focus glow; softer card shadow and roomier, consistent spacing; smooth hover transitions on inputs, buttons and links; error/success messages rendered as tinted alert boxes.

Visual only — no page, component or store logic was touched. There are no component tests in this repo to update. The recorded password rules did not apply: nothing here changes where a password is chosen.
blockers: Not applied -- 1. HeaderComponent in src/app/components/header/ declared in AppModule, gradient navbar, footer: No Angular/NgModule/navbar exists in this React + Vite repo; would mean inventing an application that isn't here
Not applied -- 2. Tutorials list card grid, search bar, status pills, empty state, Remove All button: No tutorials entity or list page exists in this repo

Not applied -- 3. Add/Edit pages as centered cards with Bootstrap alerts: No Add/Edit tutorial pages and no Bootstrap in this repo; the existing sign-up/log-in cards already received the equivalent styling
Not applied -- Update the existing component tests: This repo contains no component tests

visual_check.evidence: The /signup route renders a modern centered card on a light grey background with the Inter font, rounded inputs, an indigo-to-purple accent bar and gradient primary button, and a consistent spacing/colour scheme — the only part of the instruction (item 4) that applies to this React/Vite repo, since the Angular navbar, tutorials list and add/edit pages do not exist here. The diff touched only index.html and src/style.css, so the password-field markup was untouched and the five-rule display convention was not in scope.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: the app is a client-only React + Vite SPA that persists accounts in localStorage under the key 'acme-users' (keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) and the current session email in sessionStorage under 'acme-current'. The only paths are client-side routes handled by src/router.jsx and src/App.jsx: /signup, /login, /welcome (unknown paths fall back to Signup); the changed files (index.html, src/style.css) are markup/styling only and define no contract.
